author: TeIq
content: Implemented + tested. Migration 35 adds exp + sig columns to indexed_labels. handle_frame persists every verified label keyed by (src, uri, val, neg) with seq-monotonic upsert. 5 integration tests pass (verified_label_lands_in_indexed_labels, assert_then_negate_preserves_both_rows + the 3 pre-existing). Without #37 wired up, this code path runs only under tests — no labels actually arrive over the wire yet.
